ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 14th day of January, 2014, by and between by and between HOOD MEMORIAL AFRICAN METHODIST EPISCOPAL ZION CHURCH, having an address at 160 West 146th Street, New York, NY 10039 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and CS 122 West 146th Street LLC, having an address at c/o KLCC Investments LLC, 1350 Broadway, Suite 1010, New York, NY 10018 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 55 in Block 2014 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the "Tax Map*"), and as and by the street address 160 West 146th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 45 in Block 2014 on the Tax Map, and as and by the street address 122 west 146th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “"B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land"); WHEREAS, Developer proposes to construct a new commercial building, all or a portion of which will be on the Developer Land, but not on the Owner Parcel, and construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building and improvements, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building, as the case may be, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building is under-built, contains no commercial floor area and, consequently, less “floor area", as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Commercial Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to 2 20533425v9
